beats.subline: Monday, September 21, 2026 close — a broad tech-led rally sent the Nasdaq to a fresh record high.
beats.body: Stocks bounced back from a mostly lower week as Treasury yields and oil prices slipped; Intel jumped about 12% and AMD gained roughly 10% to cross a $1 trillion market cap, powering the Nasdaq to its first record close since June.

beats.headline: Trump addresses UN General Assembly as Iran war nears seven-month mark
beats.body: President Trump spoke to the UN General Assembly Tuesday, with Ambassador Mike Waltz saying the address would highlight peace deals, US actions in the Western Hemisphere, progress on the Gaza plan, and the need to ensure Iran never obtains a nuclear weapon; Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is scheduled to address the Assembly Wednesday.

beats.headline: Top Senate Democrat warns Trump not to waver on Taiwan ahead of Xi summit
beats.body: Sen. Jeanne Shaheen, ranking Democrat on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, said at the Concordia Summit that she hopes Trump 'will not say anything that indicates a lack of support for Taiwan' when he hosts Xi Jinping in Washington this week, as a pending $14 billion Taiwan arms sale remains a flashpoint Beijing wants scrapped before the September 24 meeting.

beats.headline: UN report says US boat strikes may amount to crimes against humanity as death toll hits 234
beats.body: A UN Special Rapporteur's report found 'reasonable grounds' that US strikes on suspected drug-trafficking boats in the Caribbean and eastern Pacific -- now 234 deaths across 70 strikes -- violate international law, but because the US isn't an ICC member and has no domestic statute criminalizing crimes against humanity, no court can try the cases; Secretary of State Rubio says every strike is reviewed by a legal officer, while the administration has sanctioned more than a dozen ICC judges and prosecutors.

beats.headline: Army's Scarlet Dragon exercise tests AI-linked defenses against 100-drone swarms
beats.body: The XVIII Airborne Corps ran a nine-day 'Scarlet Dragon' exercise at Fort Bragg combining radar, acoustic sensors and electronic warfare with AI-assisted threat prioritization to defend command posts and air-defense positions against simulated attacks by up to 100 drones at once; the Army says it's moving from evaluating individual counter-drone systems to validating networked, layered defenses at scale, with follow-on tests planned into 2027.

beats.headline: Researchers used Claude Opus 5 to build a working exploit against OpenAI's systems overnight
beats.body: Security researchers at Hacktron chained a bug in Discourse forum image-processing with a flaw in OpenAI's single sign-on system to access an internal GitHub repository, a hack Claude Opus 4.8 couldn't reliably pull off until Anthropic's newly released Opus 5 built a working exploit overnight; Claude initially refused the request until researchers reframed it as a capture-the-flag exercise, and OpenAI patched the flaw within 14 hours and paid a $6,500 bounty.

beats.headline: Ben Johnson says Caleb Williams is 'week to week' after Grade 1 hamstring strain
beats.body: Bears coach Ben Johnson said Monday that an MRI confirmed a Grade 1 hamstring strain for quarterback Caleb Williams, who is expected to be week-to-week and likely won't practice this week; Johnson stopped short of ruling Williams out for next Monday night's home game against Philadelphia, with Tyson Bagent in line to start if he can't go.
